skins.name: Rhythmic Blocks
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Rhythmic Blocks. Swire's chic and breezy concert outfit, showcasing all her vivacity and cuteness. She leads the choreography, gladly accepting the applauses and affection from her stans.
skins.usage: One of Swire the Elegant Wit's performance outfits.
skins.quote: To ensure the music video would go off without a hitch, Swire prepared as much as she could. Her group dances amidst the flickering lights, their voices carrying their song to the sky. She sets aside all titles and pretense, her only hope being that this will be an unforgettable performance.
